title: Quick German Blackcurrant Crumble
description: A classic German dessert featuring a jammy blackcurrant filling topped with a crumbly oat mixture, perfect for a crowd, this dish is a tagine-cook and dash-friendly recipe that combines the sweetness of blackcurrant jam with the warmth of cinnamon and the crunch of oats.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, mix together the rolled oats, brown sugar, ground cinnamon, ground nutmeg, and salt.
Add the cold unsalted butter to the bowl and use your fingers or a pastry blender to work the butter into the oat mixture until it resembles coarse crumbs.
In a separate bowl, stir the blackcurrant jam to loosen it.
Transfer the blackcurrant jam to a 6-inch baking dish or tagine and top with the crumb mixture, spreading it evenly.
Bake the crumble in the preheated oven for 35-40 minutes, or until the topping is golden brown and the filling is bubbly.
Remove the crumble from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before serving.
Serve the crumble warm, topped with vanilla ice cream or whipped cream if desired.
